verdict.rationale: Docs describe agent-invocable slash commands (/design, /design-sync) linking Claude Code and Claude Design, and one community report describes using an MCP flow to push Claude Design output into PenPot with reusable components, suggesting some programmatic write surface exists. However, there is no first-party documentation of an official write-capable API or MCP server, and no OpenAPI/MCP spec was found in probes. Missing for 10: official documented API/MCP tool list for creating/modifying designs, first-party corroboration of the MCP flow, and more than one anecdotal report.
